summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades. Additionally, there are ongoing considerations for patch releases for versions 1.11.1 and 1.10.3, as well as the planning for the upcoming Iceberg 1.12.0 release.
highlights: Integration efforts with Spark including variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Implementation of single-table constraint support in Iceberg
Discussion on potential patch releases for versions 1.11.1 and 1.10.3
Planning for Iceberg 1.12.0 release with a tentative target
